pages.lesson:
LESSON: READING 11.2.1 INTENSIVE READING: DIGITAL STORIES

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
Strand: Strand 11
Topic 11.2: Reading 11.2.1 Intensive Reading: Digital Stories

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Reading 11.2.1 Intensive Reading: Digital Stories. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: What role do pictures in a book or cover play in a story?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify words, phrases and proverbs from a digital text
2. create mental images from viewed, heard or read text
3. answer direct and inferential questions correctly for comprehension

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify words, phrases and proverbs from a digital text
   In simple words: practise until you can identify words, phrases and proverbs from a digital text. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. create mental images from viewed, heard or read text
   In simple words: practise until you can create mental images from viewed, heard or read text. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. answer direct and inferential questions correctly for comprehension
   In simple words: practise until you can answer direct and inferential questions correctly for comprehension. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Reading 11.2.1 Intensive Reading: Digital Stories using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Reading 11.2.1 Intensive Reading: Digital Stories in the examples.
2. Explain Reading 11.2.1 Intensive Reading: Digital Stories to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Reading 11.2.1 Intensive Reading: Digital Stories.
4. Show that you can: identify words, phrases and proverbs from a digital text

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Reading 11.2.1 Intensive Reading: Digital Stories using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Reading 11.2.1 Intensive Reading: Digital Stories important for a Grade 6 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Participate in a reader’s theatre and read solo or choral poems on indoor games,

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What role do pictures in a book or cover play in a story?
2. How are digital stories different from story books?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify words, phrases and proverbs from a digital text
2. create mental images from viewed, heard or read text
3. answer direct and inferential questions correctly for comprehension

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.
